parse_s3_url: parse an S3 virtual host style URL into region, bucket, and key components
create_s3path_instance: create an S3Path instance from a virtual host style S3 URL string
compare_s3path_equality: compare two S3Path instances for equality based on region, bucket, and key
extract_s3_bucket: extract the bucket name from an S3 virtual host style URL using S3Path
extract_s3_key: extract the object key from an S3 virtual host style URL using S3Path
